hooks.statusMessage: Checking for updates from another PC...
hooks.command: $gitExe = (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $gitExe) { $gitExe = 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' }; if (Test-Path $gitExe) { $inGit = & $gitExe rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>$null; if ($inGit -eq 'true') { & $gitExe pull --ff-only *>$null } }; exit 0
